description: Source code for the PartitionedPairBuffer class in Apache Spark, implementing an append-only buffer for key-value pairs with partition IDs, supporting dynamic resizing and sorted iteration.

classes.name: PartitionedPairBuffer
classes.description: A growable, append-only buffer for key-value pairs with partition IDs, supporting sorting and iteration.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair with partition ID into the buffer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: growArray
methods.description: Doubles the capacity of the internal array, up to a maximum, and copies existing data.

methods.name: partitionedDestructiveSortedIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the data sorted by key, possibly destructively modifying internal state.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the stored key-value pairs.
